biowasm and Aioli
=================
The WebAssembly builds of samtools, bcftools and htslib (bgzip, tabix) in this
folder, and the Aioli runner (aioli.js), come from the biowasm project
(https://biowasm.com, https://github.com/biowasm/biowasm and
https://github.com/biowasm/aioli).

samtools, bcftools and htslib
=============================
Copyright (C) Genome Research Ltd. and contributors
(https://www.htslib.org). samtools and bcftools are distributed under the
MIT/Expat licence (bcftools: MIT/Expat or, if built with the GNU Scientific
Library, GPL); htslib under the MIT/Expat and modified 3-clause BSD licences.
The full licence texts of the versions used here are next to the programs:
  samtools/1.17/LICENSE            samtools 1.17
  bcftools/1.10/LICENSE            bcftools 1.10
  bcftools/1.10/HTSLIB-1.10-LICENSE  htslib 1.10, built into bcftools 1.10
  htslib/1.17/LICENSE              htslib 1.17 (bgzip, tabix)
(taken from the release tags 1.17 and 1.10 of github.com/samtools/samtools,
/bcftools and /htslib).
